imports.title: Imports

whoop.title: Whoop export
whoop.hint: The export ZIP, or its CSV files (physiological_cycles, sleeps, workouts, journal_entries). Re-import a new export every week or two until Whoop ends: it feeds the live comparison on the Holdout tab.

garmin.title: Garmin account export
garmin.hint: The ZIP from Garmin Connect → Account → Export your data. Re-import a new export along with each Whoop export; a day exported half-finished is replaced by the newer version.

fit.title: FIT files
fit.hint: Drag in activity .fit files. Fallback when sync breaks.

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.intro: Garmin-derived Recovery, Strain and Sleep, calibrated against Whoop and checked on days the model never saw. This report is the go/no-go evidence for cancelling Whoop.
calibration.featuresHint: Recompute after importing data or changing HR max, resting HR or sex in Athletes.
calibration.recomputed: Recomputed {{days}} days ({{paired}} paired). Activity loads: {{fromStream}} from per-second HR, {{fromAverage}} from average HR, {{withoutLoad}} without.
calibration.scored: Daily scores from {{model}}: {{days}} days ({{withRecovery}} with recovery, {{withStrain}} with strain). Last data: {{lastDataDate}}.
calibration.profileChanged: HR max or resting HR differs from the values the active model was calibrated with: scores are flagged until you recalibrate.
calibration.noHrMax: Set HR max in Athletes: without it there is no training load, and strain cannot be calibrated.
calibration.sexAssumed: Sex is not set: male TRIMP constants were used.
calibration.empty: No features yet: press Recompute features.

stat.noBaseline: Garmin days still building a baseline

calibration.runHint: On the machine running the app, in the repository folder:

contractIssue.FEATURE_VERSION: Built on feature set {{featureVersion}}, which the app no longer computes. Press Recompute features and run a new calibration.
contractIssue.SCHEMA_VERSION: Old calibration format (before 0.6.0) that daily scoring can't read. Run a new calibration.

calibration.olderThanActive: Older than the active version, so it can't replace it. Run a new calibration instead.
calibration.activeContractIssue: This active version uses an old format: activate a newer version before daily scoring starts.
calibration.confirmActivate: Activate {{version}}? It becomes the model for daily scores and for the live comparison with Whoop. The currently active version is retired.

coverage.title: Data coverage
coverage.intro: Days with complete Garmin and Whoop data are the ones Phase 1 can calibrate on.
coverage.definition: Garmin complete = resting HR + overnight HRV + main sleep. Whoop complete = recovery + day strain.

feed.title: Keeping it fed
feed.summary: Last Whoop day {{whoop}} · last Garmin day {{garmin}} · last scored day {{scored}}
feed.recompute: New data was imported after the last Recompute features: press Calibration → Recompute features to score it.
feed.garminBehind: Garmin data ends on {{garmin}}, Whoop on {{whoop}}: the days in between wait as "no score from us yet" until the next Garmin export.
feed.step1: Every week or two, request both exports: the Whoop data export, and the Garmin account export (Garmin's email can take a few days).
feed.step2: Imports: upload each ZIP as it arrives, unchanged, in the order you requested them. Uploading the same file twice adds nothing.
feed.step3: Calibration: press Recompute features once both are in.
feed.step4: Come back here: the window grows to the last finished Whoop day. Today's Whoop day is not compared until a later export holds it finished.
feed.last: Whoop ends {{end}}. Take the last Whoop export that day, and a Garmin export after it; import both, press Recompute features, then download the decision report and keep it.

holdout.title: Live comparison with Whoop
holdout.intro: Our scores next to Whoop's on days the active model has never seen, until the Whoop subscription ends. The rules (ADR 0009) were fixed before any of these days was looked at: the pass marks are frozen and no day can be left out by hand.

state.NOT_ENOUGH_DAYS_BY_RULE: Not enough days by the rule

verdict.NOT_ENOUGH_DAYS_YET: {{n}} of {{min}} compared recovery days. No mark is judged before {{min}}; the numbers below are shown with their uncertainty.
verdict.INTERIM: {{n}} compared recovery days. Interim: the verdict can still change until the last Whoop day.
verdict.FINAL: {{n}} compared recovery days, up to the last Whoop day. This is the final verdict.
verdict.NOT_ENOUGH_DAYS_BY_RULE: The comparison ended with {{n}} of {{min}} compared recovery days. The decision is yours, taken knowing this.

holdout.windowEmpty: Window starts {{from}}; no finished Whoop day in it yet. Import a new Whoop export, then press Recompute features. Whoop ends {{end}}.
holdout.frozen: Pass marks frozen at activation ({{when}}), source {{source}}, protocol {{protocol}}.
holdout.retired: This version was retired on {{when}} when another was activated. Its comparison stopped then and is kept as it was.
holdout.noScoreYet_one: {{count}} day with Whoop data has no score from us yet (our last scored day: {{last}}). Press Calibration → Recompute features.
holdout.noScoreYet_other: {{count}} days with Whoop data have no score from us yet (our last scored day: {{last}}). Press Calibration → Recompute features.
holdout.stale_one: {{count}} day was scored before the latest import. Press Calibration → Recompute features.
holdout.stale_other: {{count}} days were scored before the latest import. Press Calibration → Recompute features.
holdout.marksHint: A mark is met when its measured value meets it; the 95% interval shows how sure that is. Strain is judged on days with at least 10 h of all-day heart rate. The recovery marks matter most: they drive training decisions.
holdout.evidenceHint: Rates are shares of compared days with their 95% interval (k/n, low–high). MAE: average difference, ours − Whoop. Spearman: how well the two put the days in the same order (1 = same order).
holdout.naive: Simple baseline: yesterday's Whoop as today's guess
holdout.naiveHint: On the {{n}} days where our recovery, Whoop's and Whoop's for the day before all exist ({{skipped}} skipped: no Whoop the day before). No pass mark: it answers "are we better than copying yesterday?".
holdout.driftHint: The last 4 weeks and each week, to spot a change early. Not used for the verdict.
holdout.recomputeRuns_one: {{count}} Recompute features run in the window
holdout.recomputeRuns_other: {{count}} Recompute features runs in the window
holdout.profileChanged_one: {{count}} day scored with HR max / resting HR different from the model's
holdout.profileChanged_other: {{count}} days scored with HR max / resting HR different from the model's

group.NO_SCORE_YET: No score from us yet (press Recompute features)
group.UNKNOWN: No score from us (no reason stored)
group.NO_GARMIN_CORE: Missing resting HR, overnight HRV or sleep
